verdict.rationale: Elicit's 'Alerts' feature lets a user set a topic and receive an automatic email notification when a new relevant paper is found, which is a narrow event→action automation, but there is no general rule-builder allowing arbitrary triggers/conditions/actions across the product. Missing for 10: user-defined trigger conditions beyond 'new paper found', support for actions besides email alerts, and any workflow/automation engine tying events to custom actions.
